title: Colts CB Justin Walley returns favor with pick-six in joint-practice against Falcons

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Colts CB Justin Walley returns favor with pick-six in joint-practice against Falcons
sources.description: Walley read it perfectly to jump in front of the pass, then briefly juggled the interception before he secured it and raced down the far sideline for a pick-six.
